name: nacebel-codes-pulumi
description: Pulumi program for nacebel.codes: the Stripe dataset catalogue and the app-owned Vercel env.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && node -e "if(!require('typescript').ScriptTarget)throw new Error('pulumi/ needs a TypeScript with a JS API (5.x): Pulumi serializes closures through it, and pulumi preview/up fail without one')"
